name: ALERT_PACKETS
tagline: A one-page decoder and encoder for ALERT/ERTS packets (ABF, BCC, EAF, EIF), built on the Bureau's ERTS Data Formats spec.
about: Paste a 40-bit framed message, a 32-bit payload or 8-digit hex and it is decoded against every known format, with check bits and CRC validated and a colour-coded bit map; or encode the other way. Decoded addresses are named from a national ALERT address file, and the page can be driven from the URL with a JSON result. Flood-Net absorbed it: its ALERT Packets tab (packets.js) is the maintained port, carrying the same address file and spec byte for byte.

status.summary: Works as published but superseded by Flood-Net's ALERT Packets tab; last touched 13 Oct 2026, for a CLAUDE.md note only.
next: Point the README at Flood-Net's ALERT Packets tab as the maintained version

components.name: Decoder and encoder page
components.what: ABF, BCC, EAF and EIF decode and encode with check bits, CRC-6 and framing polarity.

components.name: URL interface
components.what: ?decode= and ?encode= in the address, with &json=1 for a JSON result.

components.name: ALERT address file
components.what: National ALERT address → station name list used to name decoded readings.

components.name: ERTS Data Formats spec
components.what: The Bureau of Meteorology's July 2003 format document the codec follows.
